title: Run request, version 2
description: Body of POST /api/runs: the physical battery and the horizon, and nothing financial. Financial inputs live in the browser and never enter this request or the params hash. Rules a schema cannot state are in contracts/README.md: 364 <= end - start <= 730 days, and the dates inside the price data.

power_mw.description: Power delivered to the grid (P of model.md §2), the contracted availability in the contracted case, MW.

volume_mwh.description: Nominal storage volume before degradation (E), MWh.

max_charge_mw.description: Maximum charge rate, on the grid side, MW.

max_discharge_mw.description: Maximum discharge rate, on the storage side, MW.

charge_efficiency.description: One-way charging efficiency: the share of grid energy that reaches the store.

discharge_efficiency.description: One-way discharging efficiency: the share of stored energy that reaches the grid.

degradation_pct_per_cycle.description: Percent of the nominal volume lost per equivalent full cycle.

cycle_budget.description: Physical equivalent full cycles allowed over the run's horizon. Omitted, not null, when there is no budget.

prices_key.description: S3 key of an uploaded hourly PLD CSV, uploads/<sha256>.csv. Absent: the bundled CCEE series.
